Subject: Request: Dedicated GPU pool architecture review (Ember POC)

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Ember is moving from trial to a short POC where we'll need dedicated GPU capacity to support mixed real-time and batch workloads. We want a technical deep-dive with your infra/ops folks to align on: pool sizing, autoscaling behavior under burst, and isolation/tenant failover.

Suggested attendees from our side: Priya (SRE lead), Samira (infra consultant), and two backend engineers.

Can we lock a 90-minute session next week? Our preference is May 25–27 (PDT mornings). If you have a pre-read or prework we should fill out, send it along and we'll complete before the meeting.

Thanks,
Alex Torres
Head of Platform, Ember AI
Attachments: ember-prework-capacity.xlsx (spreadsheet with current load profile)

We can slot the deep-dive to cover: expected steady-state throughput, burst profiles, preferred isolation mode (hard tenant separation vs soft quotas), and rollback/fallback plans. - Tue May 25, 9:30–11:00
